name: User Ratings 1.0.2.0: run by scripts/userratings-details-probe.mjs after it seeded more than 20 synthetic members' ratings and reviews and viewer's own on Long Test Movie; as viewer2: the average with viewer's rating in it, the counts, the histogram and viewer's row (item 2a without the chip); every name and text isolated and as text; Show more on a long review; Load more past 20, each row once; the four orders as the server gives them; Load more's 403 shows "Reviews are turned off on this server." and removes the list and the form, with no error.

steps.name: Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: "Long Test Movie", Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: the server: Long Test Movie, seeded
the seed is there: more than 20 other members' rows (run through userratings-details-probe.mjs)

steps.name: Long Test Movie: its details page
Long Test Movie: the section mounted for it
viewer2 sees the members' average with viewer's rating in it, the counts, the histogram, viewer's row in the list (without the chip)
steps.assert: (s => s.summaryKind === 'average' && s.average === 'Member average ' + (Math.round(__vars.seeded.average * 10) / 10).toFixed(1) + ' out of 5, ' + __vars.seeded.count + ' ratings' && s.histogram && /^How members rated: /.test(s.histogram.label) && s.histogram.shown && s.names.indexOf('viewer') >= 0 && s.reviews.length === 20 && s.pager && s.toolbar)(__vars.rvState)

steps.name: the counts as the server has them
Load more: the section's requests since
the next page's query
steps.eval: (() => { const q = new URLSearchParams(__jfurDetails.requests[__jfurDetails.requests.length - 1].query); return { startIndex: q.get('startIndex'), limit: q.get('limit'), sort: q.get('sort') }; })()

steps.name: the next page (startIndex 20), every row once, Load more gone at the end (paging past 20)
names and texts isolated, texts as text (an override left open stays in its element; "<b>" is text)
steps.eval: (() => { const st = __jfurDetails.styles(); const s = __jfurDetails.section(); return { isolated: st.isolated.filter(i => /jfur-review-(name|text)/.test(i.cls)), b: s.querySelectorAll('.jfur-review b').length, rlo: Array.prototype.filter.call(s.querySelectorAll('.jfur-review-text'), n => n.textContent.indexOf('\u202E') >= 0).length, html: Array.prototype.filter.call(s.querySelectorAll('.jfur-review-text'), n => n.textContent.indexOf('<b>') >= 0).length, arabic: Array.prototype.filter.call(s.querySelectorAll('.jfur-review-name'), n => /[\u0600-\u06FF]/.test(n.textContent)).length }; })()

steps.name: every name and text dir="auto" and unicode-bidi: isolate; the seeded override, Arabic name and "<b>" there, no HTML from a review
the long review: its Show more
steps.eval: (() => { const b = __jfurDetails.section().querySelector('.jfur-review-more'); const t = b.parentNode.querySelector('.jfur-review-text'); return { label: b.textContent, expanded: b.getAttribute('aria-expanded'), lines: t.textContent.split('\n').length, ellipsis: /…$/.test(t.textContent) }; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const b = __jfurDetails.section().querySelector('.jfur-review-more'); const t = b.parentNode.querySelector('.jfur-review-text'); return { label: b.textContent, expanded: b.getAttribute('aria-expanded'), lines: t.textContent.split('\n').length, ellipsis: /…$/.test(t.textContent) }; })()

steps.name: the list in view
steps.script: __jfurDetails.section().querySelector('.jfur-review-more').scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); return true;
